category5.design: The library never calls blosc2_remove_urlpath itself (no harness reaches it) and its input is a directory tree, so the PoV is an archive and a driver calls the API on it. A match on `exists=1` (the path survives) is used instead of output-diff because a missing path also changes rc on the injected build, which would let an empty archive pass.
